notes: P04 PST-X06_key_rotation deliverable (ReceiptMin RQ3 — retention, key-deletion and proof-generation costs across retention epochs): evaluation/venue2027/pst/epoch_keys.py implements the retention-epoch pseudonym key lifecycle per the task contract and the threat model (T2/T3 key custody outside the P1 read-only audit privilege, asset S2 consent/policy epoch proof, excluded domain X2, PST-CASE-07 fail-closed discipline). Derivation is real RFC 5869 HKDF (HMAC-SHA256 extract + expand, stdlib hmac/hashlib only) over a caller-injected root secret with length-prefixed domain-separated info ('clara.pst.epoch_keys.v1' || tenant || purpose || epoch) so no scope tuple aliases another; conformant to the RFC 5869 Appendix A Test Case 1 vector (asserted in tests). Public API per the deliverable: derive_key(root, tenant, purpose, epoch) -> (key_material, key_ref) pure and deterministic (same scope+epoch yields the same key; new epoch differs); rotate(tenant, purpose) via module-level rotate(...) closes the live epoch (manifest records created/destroyed timestamps and derived key reference) and derives+registers the fresh epoch e<N+1>, cryptographically independent of every prior epoch; destroy(epoch) via module-level destroy(...) performs CONTROLLED, policy-gated destruction where permitted (destroyable=True) and refuses legal-hold scopes with DESTROY_NOT_PERMITTED while they stay live. Every scope carries an explicit reversibility record: manifest.reversibility() returns IRREVERSIBLE for destroyed epochs (the manifest stores only SHA-256 key references, so destruction erases the only derivation path and authorized-audit reconstruction is impossible) and REVERSIBLE for live custody; unverified custody would be INDETERMINATE per X2 (no HSM-extraction claim). Raw key material MUST NOT log or expose: artifacts are key_ref (SHA-256 over 'ref.v1' || OKM) and nonce-free HMAC verification tokens only; tests scan every manifest serialization, scope artifact and error message for the derived bytes, their hex and the root secret — never present. All failures are stable uppercase reason codes (MALFORMED_SCOPE, UNKNOWN_PURPOSE, UNKNOWN_EPOCH, UNKNOWN_TENANT, EPOCH_ALREADY_DESTROYED, DESTROY_NOT_PERMITTED) — destroyed-epoch re-derivation fails closed (EPOCH_ALREADY_DESTROYED), never a silent reconstruction; rotation is idempotent per stable scope id (identical re-register collapses; conflicting re-register is refused so manifest history cannot be rewritten); timestamps are caller-injected logical instants (no hidden clock). No production secret or data access; fixtures are synthetic and PHI-free. test_key_rotation.py (research/venue2027/pst/tests/test_key_rotation.py): 41 tests pass — positive: deterministic same-scope-same-key, cross-root-form determinism, 32-byte keys, stable hex references, verification-token possession proof, RFC 5869 conformance vector, epoch/tenant/purpose separation, length-prefix anti-aliasing, rotation manifest records the change (e1 destroyed@10 + e2 created@10 with distinct key refs), JSON-serializability, stable scope_key_id, controlled destruction + IRREVERSIBLE, legal hold stays REVERSIBLE; adversarial: destroyed-epoch key unusable and reconstruction reported IRREVERSIBLE, double-destroy refused, re-register of destroyed scope refused, rotation without live epoch fails closed, unknown tenant/epoch fail-closed reason codes, raw key material absent from manifest/artifacts/error messages, key_ref is one-way (not material, not truncation), token != key, malformed scopes and unknown purposes refused, closed purpose vocabulary, manifest-history rewrite refused, PHI-marker-free vocabulary. uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check clean on touched files; full evaluation/venue2027 regression 1849 passed. source_sha_after = base commit 85cd5675 per the sibling dataset-task convention (PST-dataset, PST-X02): the single task commit is created immediately after this report and recorded in the commit body.
